name: Codru Nature Reserve (Codrii)
blurb: Oak and beech hill forest where martens, buzzards and dormice share a woodland web.

tip.title: Remove the beech nuts
tip.text: Set European beech to -100% and watch edible dormice, hawfinches, great tits and roe deer, then the marten and buzzard that hunt them.

notes: The species list comes from GBIF occurrence records inside a circle around the park, so it can include nearby areas. Feeding links come from GloBI records and the sources listed where they state them; others are general ecology and are illustrative.

nodes.desc: Light reaching the forest floor drives the spring herb layer and the growth of canopy leaves.
Moldova has a dry continental climate, so rain and soil moisture set how well the hill forests grow.
Fallen leaves and wood break down into the soil nutrients that the trees take up again.
Break down leaf litter, dead wood and carcasses, returning nutrients to the soil.
A broadleaf canopy tree of the hill forests. Its acorns, leaves and dead wood feed many animals.
A tall shade-casting canopy tree whose nuts are eaten by rodents, birds and deer.
A common mid-canopy tree of Central European broadleaf forest that produces winged seeds.
A small deer that browses grass, leaves, berries and young shoots in woodland and edges.
A tree-climbing rodent of broadleaf forest that eats nuts, seeds and fruit.
A cavity-nesting songbird that eats insects and seeds, including beech nuts.

nodes.name: European grass snake
nodes.desc: A snake that hunts mainly amphibians, often at pond and stream edges.
Digs beetle larvae from wood, eats tree seeds, and sometimes raids tit nests for eggs and chicks.
A large omnivorous crow that scavenges carrion among other foods.
An agile woodland predator that eats small mammals, birds, frogs, insects and fruit.
A generalist raptor that hunts small mammals, birds, reptiles and amphibians, and sometimes takes carrion.

story: Codru Nature Reserve is a scientific reserve located in Străşeni District, Moldova. Established in 1971, it encompasses 5,177 hectares of protected forest ecosystem. The reserve is situated in the central part of Moldova and includes the Condriȓa forest reserve area.
matters: The Codru Reserve is the single known Moldovan location for the gastropod species Bulgarica cana and protects part of the forest ecosystem of the Codri area.
